mapper.sql: c.*, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, a.title AS article_title
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blog_site_config WHERE config_key = 'comment' FOR UPDATE

SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_comment r WHERE r.article_id = c.article_id AND r.parent_id = c.comment_id AND r.status IN (1,3)) AS reply_count FROM blog_comment c JOIN blog_article a ON a.article_id = c.article_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.article_id = #{article} AND c.status IN (1,3) AND c.parent_id = #{parent} AND c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.comment_id DESC

SELECT c.* FROM blog_comment c SELECT FROM blog_comment c JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id JOIN blog_article a ON a.article_id = c.article_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{id} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blog_article s WHERE s.article_id = c.article_id AND s.author_id = #{author}) AND c.user_id = #{user} FOR UPDATE
